title: Long Ago & Me
description: Explore personal change, sources that help us learn about long ago, then-and-now objects, and similarities and differences between classrooms past and present.
learningFocus: Use photos, stories, saved objects, and familiar examples to describe how people and places change over time.
Compare life long ago with life today while recognizing that some older tools and traditions are still used.
adultGuidance: Talk through each page before your child draws, matches, or circles. For the scored activities, page 2 answers are old photo, saved things, and story; page 3 matches candle to lamp, horse and carriage to car, and letter to phone; page 4 answers are SAME, DIFFERENT, DIFFERENT. Remind children that letters and candles are still used today, even though many people also use phones and electric lamps.
